name: Registered Land Ownership or Lease Deed Presence
failure_message: Registered land ownership or registered lease deed (minimum 30 years) is missing or unverified.
recommended_action: Upload officially registered deed of land ownership or continuous 30-year lease deed registered with Sub-Registrar.

name: Minimum Land Area Requirement Compliance
failure_message: Declared contiguous land area does not satisfy the statutory minimum requirement (minimum 2.5 acres in semi-urban / 1.5 acres in metro).
recommended_action: Submit rectified land revenue demarcation report showing requisite contiguous acreage.

name: Land Survey Number Cross-Consistency
failure_message: Survey number declared in Affidavit differs from survey number in Land Deed.
recommended_action: Ensure uniform survey/khasra numbers across revenue records, affidavit, and municipal approvals.

name: Competent Authority Occupancy / Completion Certificate
failure_message: Permanent Occupancy / Completion Certificate issued by competent municipal authority is missing.
recommended_action: Furnish valid Occupancy / Completion Certificate from Town Planning / Municipal Authority.

name: Structural Stability Certificate by Certified Structural Engineer
logic: has_document('Structural Stability Certificate') && is_recent('Structural Stability Certificate', 'issue_date', 365)
failure_message: Structural Stability Certificate is missing or exceeds allowable renewal period.
recommended_action: Submit structural safety assessment signed and stamped by an empanelled structural engineer.

name: Built-up Carpet Area Requirement for Academic Infrastructure
failure_message: Total instructional and administrative carpet area is inadequate for declared student intake.
recommended_action: Review architectural layout and submit revised built-up area schedule meeting AICTE Norms [SOURCE: TO BE VERIFIED].

name: Fire Safety Certificate / NOC Validity
failure_message: Fire Safety Certificate is missing, unverified, or has expired beyond grace period.
recommended_action: Obtain and upload renewed Fire NOC issued by Chief Fire Officer / District Fire Authority.

name: Cadre Ratio and Minimum Core Faculty Sufficiency
failure_message: Total qualified faculty strength is below statutory AICTE Student-Faculty Ratio (1:20 for Engineering / 1:25 for Polytechnic).
recommended_action: Complete recruitment of designated Professors, Associate Professors, and Assistant Professors.

name: Faculty Appointment Letters and Board Approval Records
logic: has_document('Faculty Appointment Letter') && extracted('Faculty Appointment Letter', 'appointment_date') != null
failure_message: Appointment letters or selection committee approval resolutions missing for declared regular faculty.
recommended_action: Upload 7th CPC appointment orders and university ratification approvals.

name: Faculty Qualification Verification (M.Tech / Ph.D. Registry)
logic: has_document('Faculty Qualification Certificate') && verification_status('Faculty Qualification Certificate') == 'Verified'
failure_message: Principal / HoD highest degree certificate could not be authenticated via University / National Academic Depository.
recommended_action: Provide verified NAD/DigiLocker document URI for faculty credentials.

name: Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) Establishment
failure_message: Mandatory IQAC establishment declaration and committee composition record absent.
recommended_action: Attach official committee notification and minutes of previous IQAC meeting.

name: Statutory Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad Constitution
failure_message: Mandatory Anti-Ragging Committee, Squad, and 24x7 helpline declarations missing.
recommended_action: Furnish institutional anti-ragging squad notification with contact coordinates.

name: Student and Faculty Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC) & Ombudsperson
failure_message: Affidavit lacks declaration of Student Grievance Redressal Committee or university-appointed Ombudsperson.
recommended_action: Submit SGRC committee constitution notification and Ombudsperson details.

name: Chartered Accountant Certified Audited Financial Statements
logic: has_document('Audited Financial Statement') && extracted('Audited Financial Statement', 'ca_membership_no') != null
failure_message: Audited balance sheet with verified UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number) is absent.
recommended_action: Upload previous financial year Balance Sheet and Income & Expenditure account with ICAI UDIN.

name: Joint Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) / Endowment Corpus Compliance
failure_message: Joint FDR with Regional Officer, AICTE for corpus endowment has not been deposited.
recommended_action: Submit bank confirmation letter of Joint FDR for the required amount.

name: Programme Intake Consistency and Accreditation Eligibility
failure_message: Intake expansion exceeding 50% requested without valid NBA accreditation in core programmes.
recommended_action: Furnish NBA accreditation certificate (minimum 3 years validity) for programmes seeking intake expansion.

name: Prior Academic Year AICTE Approval Status Verification
failure_message: Preceding academic year AICTE Extension of Approval (EoA) letter is not linked.
recommended_action: Attach official AICTE approval order issued for academic session 2025-2026.

name: Prescribed Format Notarized Affidavit Submission
failure_message: Mandatory composite affidavit in AICTE prescribed format on Rs. 100/- non-judicial stamp paper is missing or un-notarized.
recommended_action: Execute sworn affidavit before First Class Judicial Magistrate / Notary Public.

name: Registered Society / Trust / Section 8 Company Deed
failure_message: Registration certificate and constitutional memorandum of sponsoring society/trust not uploaded.
recommended_action: Upload certified copy of Trust Deed / Society registration certificate.

name: State Government and Affiliating University NOC
failure_message: No Objection Certificate (NOC) from State Directorate of Technical Education / Affiliating University is absent.
recommended_action: Procure and submit formal NOC issued by State Higher & Technical Education department.

name: Institution and Sponsoring Body Name Consistency
logic: extracted('Affidavit', 'institution_name') == application.institution_name && (extracted('Land Deed', 'grantee_name') == null || extracted('Land Deed', 'grantee_name') == institution.trust_name)
failure_message: Mismatch detected between declared institution name or sponsoring body/grantee name across statutory records.
recommended_action: Submit registered gazette notification or official resolution rectifying name discrepancy.

name: Chronological Validity and Execution Date Sequences
failure_message: Affidavit execution date exceeds 90 days prior to application submission.
recommended_action: Re-affirm affidavit with fresh notarization within the current approval cycle.
